title: Interaction
slide_intent: Show which elements first orient a visitor to a shopping interface: who operates it, how to enter, and what service is available.
strategic_value: The carrot symbol and a direct service headline can connect recognition with the choice to log in or sign up.
demonstration: A cropped browser mockup shows the carrot at the upper left, account actions and the beginning of a grocery delivery or pickup headline. A cursor is visible within the page.
practical_value: Use the composition to prioritize the service message and account controls. The PDF still supports layout analysis rather than timing a cursor interaction.

content_islands.spec: Place Interaction on the dark green guide field.

content_islands.name: Browser detail
content_islands.spec: Enlarge the browser until it extends beyond the guide edges. Preserve the top bar, carrot, account links and headline as one coordinated group.
